content: संक्रम् €1 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To come or meet together. .²2 To traverse, cross, go or pass through. .²3 To approach, go. .²4 To go over or be transferred (to another). .²5 To enter on or in; कालो ह्ययं संक्रमितुं द्वितीयं सर्वोपकारक्षममाश्रमं ते <ls>R. 5. 10</ls>. .²6 To be present at, attend. .²7 To surmount. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To transfer. .²2 To devolve, consign, entrust; ब्राह्मणसंक्रमिताक्षरेण पितामहेन <ls>V. 3</ls>; <ls>Ku. 6. 78</ls>. .²3 To deliver, hand over. .²4 To convey, lead towards. .²5 To take possession of. .²6 To promise mutual assistance.
